versions.changelog:
Initial release of Chore Wheel Genius.

- Fairly assigns household chores based on skills, availability, age, and chore history.
- Supports chore rotation, unpleasant chore tracking, and effort-weighted balancing.
- Tracks completions, detects freeloaders, and provides fairness scores.
- Generates chore charts and multi-week fairness reports.
- Command-line interface for adding members/chores, assigning, tracking, and reporting.
